System

Enemy spawning, defeat ledger, XP and group credit

An encounter owns spawn generations and legitimate participation. Defeat creates a durable receipt before XP/loot success is announced, so corpse reload or server restart cannot reward the same enemy twice.

Scope and player interaction

An encounter owns spawn generations and legitimate participation. Defeat creates a durable receipt before XP/loot success is announced, so corpse reload or server restart cannot reward the same enemy twice.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase08committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Dormant → Spawning → Active → DefeatedPendingCommit → Rewarded → CorpseAvailable → RespawnScheduled

WBP_HUD observes results from URPGEncounterComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Encounter_WestRoad. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
EncounterId and SpawnSiteId: stable authored IDs
SpawnGeneration: monotonic generation for one life; paired with ZoneInstanceId/world epoch
DefeatId: unique zone/site/generation record; database uniqueness
Contribution: verified damage/heal/support events with CharacterId and time
EligiblePartySnapshot: party revision, nearby alive/participating members under declared policy
XPReward: integer definition value; allocation is deterministic given eligibility
RespawnAtUtc: persisted or explicit reset policy, never recomputed as immediate on reload

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGEncounterComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_HUDLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
ActivateSpawnSite(SiteId, Generation) -> Spawned|Occupied|InvalidNavigation
RecordContribution(VerifiedEvent) -> Counted|Ineligible; server
FinalizeDefeat(DefeatId, EligibilitySnapshot) -> CommittedRewards|Pending|AlreadyFinalized
ScheduleRespawn(SiteId, Generation, Time) -> Scheduled|StaleGeneration

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Zone encounter owner validates an authored site and creates one enemy generation, recording its stable source identity.
  2. Server hit/effect events update contribution; nearby idle alts are not eligible solely because their UI shows a target.
  3. At health zero, atomically transition to DefeatedPendingCommit once and freeze further attacks/reset; calculate eligibility from current authenticated character/party snapshots.
  4. Submit the defeat command with unique DefeatId. Backend persists defeat, per-character XP allocations, reward entitlements and receipt together; later loot materialization references these entitlements.
  5. Only committed result updates PlayerState XP/level and corpse/loot access. Timeout preserves Pending and reconciles the original command, not a new defeat.
  6. Respawn uses a new generation after the configured interval. Old corpse/reward commands reference the old generation and cannot grant from the new enemy.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create DA_Encounter_WestRoad with a stable site list, enemy definition, respawn policy and reward rule. Populate one site first.
  2. Place BP_EncounterSpawner and its patrol/home markers in L_Rillmere; server only spawns live enemies. Clients never run the spawning timer.
  3. Introduce DB_encounter_resolutions, DB_command_receipts and the minimal Party_AB fixture before enabling group rewards. Full party invitations/chat remain Phase 19.
  4. Reopen URPGEffectRules to emit verified contribution to the encounter owner; reopen ARPGEnemyCharacter's death path to call FinalizeDefeat once.
  5. Reopen WBP_HUD to observe committed XP revision. Display pending reward notification during a backend delay rather than an uncommitted item count.

Reopen Phase08 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / Encounter_WestRoad / Party_AB. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Two simultaneous lethal hits -> one DefeatId, one set of allocations.
Corpse unloaded/reloaded -> existing reward state restored, no second XP.
Kill then database timeout after commit -> receipt query restores original allocations.
Evade before defeat -> no XP/loot, contribution cleared by reset policy.
Client forges contribution -> ignored; only zone-authorized verified events accepted.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Training enemy gives 40 XP. Eligible two-person party splits 20/20 initially; contribution proximity proposal 3000 cm and recent activity 30 seconds. Personal loot allocations avoid early need/greed UI; balancing may revise this policy.

Log defeat identity, eligibility snapshot, XP allocations and receipt revision. Track pending-reward age and duplicate suppression. Database outage policy stops new reward-producing encounters once bounded pending capacity is reached.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
